summary: Transcode Therapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing the adjournment of its 2026 Annual Meeting to July 20 due to Nasdaq's pending review of its initial listing application concerning Proposal 1 (conversion of Series A/B convertible preferred stock). No material transaction—the adjournment is an administrative postponement to await Nasdaq approval. No deal terms, price, or premium are involved. The filing is a routine update on meeting logistics, not a special situation.
